question: I want my coding agent to answer Stellar questions from live sources. Which MCP servers can I connect for Stellar docs and ecosystem data, and how do they differ?

golden.answer: SDF documents two. Raven (`https://raven.stellar.org/mcp`) is a hosted server with OAuth sign-in; its `search` and `execute` tools combine Stellar Docs with live ecosystem data from Lumenloop, Stellar Light and ecosystem skills. The Stellar Docs MCP server (`https://developers.stellar.org/mcp`) needs no sign-in and serves only the official docs. Community servers also exist; check the current Building with AI page.
keyFacts: Raven is a hosted MCP server at raven.stellar.org that requires sign-in.
Raven combines Stellar documentation with live ecosystem data.
The Stellar Docs MCP server at developers.stellar.org/mcp needs no sign-in.
The Stellar Docs MCP server serves only the official documentation.
avoid: Do NOT say the Stellar Docs MCP server requires sign-in or an API key.
golden.notes: Live roster. Accept further servers named with a source, such as the OpenZeppelin, Stellar Scout, Lumenloop, or XDR MCP servers. Do not require tool names or client setup commands.

truth.notes: Raven is both a subject of this case and the system under test; the golden rests on the SDF docs page, the SDF ecosystem-resources repository and direct endpoint probes, not on Raven output. Community servers observed 2026-11-14: OpenZeppelin MCP (mcp.openzeppelin.com), kalepail/stellar-mcp-server, stellar-experimental/mcp-stellar-xdr, Stellar Scout MCP, LumenLoop MCP.

sources.quote: Raven is a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents, hosted at raven.stellar.org.
It needs no sign-in, it is read-only apart from feedback, and it serves the same published content you see here.
Use it when you want answers grounded in the official docs and nothing else. Use Raven when you also want live ecosystem data.
Stellar MCP server for AI agents: one authenticated gateway to official docs, live ecosystem data, community intel, and tested playbooks.
Stellar Scout MCP; LumenLoop MCP: Read-only Stellar ecosystem MCP: 18 tools over projects, SCF, news, media.
